hook: Your Sun is being filmed right now.
title: Your Sun Has an Indian Camera Crew
description:
India's Aditya-L1 reached its halo orbit at the Sun-Earth L1 point in January 2024. From about 1.5 million km away it keeps watching the Sun. Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #ISRO
comment_prompt: Proud of ISRO? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your Sun is being filmed right now.
scenes.headline: SUN, LIVE

scenes.narration: India's Aditya-L1 does it from space.
scenes.headline: ADITYA-L1

scenes.narration: It parks about 1.5 million kilometres away.
scenes.headline: PARKED IN SPACE

scenes.narration: That spot is called Lagrange point one.
scenes.headline: LAGRANGE POINT 1

scenes.narration: Gravity there helps it stay put.
scenes.headline: GRAVITY HELPS

scenes.narration: It reached that orbit in January 2024.
scenes.headline: JANUARY 2024

scenes.narration: From there it sees the Sun nonstop.
scenes.headline: NO NIGHT, NO ECLIPSE

scenes.narration: So your Sun has an Indian camera crew.
scenes.headline: SUN CAMERA CREW

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a camera trick that bends fans.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW
